Exam grading is an education-sector use, recorded under the sectoral study.

facts.fact: The education ministry inaugurated a modernised State Exam grading centre in Kinshasa on 10 April 2025 running the AI-using software Snote Manager to process test items.
The document says Snote Manager, AI-using grading software, was developed by the Ministry of National Education and New Citizenship and is in use at its grading centre.
